purpose: Authorize a separate synthetic-only sibling model/interface lineage constrained to fields actually available in canonical DEV2000 PRE, while keeping Frozen N2 unchanged as the comparison baseline and keeping all real-outcome, price, economics, real-data fitting, promotion, Runtime and betting boundaries closed.

owner_gate_evidence.owner_directive_exact: 既存DEV2000 PREで実際に利用可能な項目だけを前提とする別系統モデル／interfaceの設計・合成アブレーション研究を許可。Frozen N2は変更せず比較基準として維持する。目的は、欠損しているline_group_id・line_position・line_size・bank_length_m・wind_speed_mpsへの依存度を合成環境で評価し、これらを使わない系統が成立するか判定すること。RESULT/PAYOUT・outcome・odds/price・economics・ECON_HOLDOUT1000・DEV2000 C・実データ学習/fit/選択・model promotion・新規自動大量収集・外部provider連絡・Runtime・自動投票は引き続き禁止。

authorized_scope: design a separate sibling PRE interface using only field families already demonstrated present in canonical DEV2000 PRE schema
design separate sibling synthetic model candidates without modifying Frozen N2
run synthetic-only ablations that remove or withhold line_group_id, line_position, line_size, bank_length_m and wind_speed_mps
compare sibling synthetic behavior against Frozen N2 only inside synthetic worlds
evaluate synthetic robustness, calibration behavior, sensitivity and technical viability without real outcomes or real fitting
explicitly_not_authorized: outcome, finish position, winner or settlement label access
odds, price or market data access
economics, bankroll, ROI or profit evaluation
real PRE training, fitting, tuning, parameter selection or model selection
model promotion, freeze acceptance or production deployment
external provider contact, payment, credential use or contract action
Runtime activation, automatic betting or real-money wagering
activation_rule: Authority is active only when one atomic canonical main commit contains this receipt plus matching v3/historical_all_market/governance/CURRENT_STATE_KEIRIN.json, multiverse_vnext/VNEXT_CURRENT_STATE_v0.json generation 15, and KEIRIN_NOW.md.
scope_expansion_rule: Any use of real outcomes, RESULT/PAYOUT, odds/prices, economics, real-data fitting/selection, model promotion, Runtime or betting requires a separate explicit governed Owner Gate.
